go_no_go_rule: No expensive install or inference unless compatible Linux NVIDIA GPU >=24GB and approved cloud expense are available; no low-spec runtime inference.

trial_definition.asset_type: Shire original wicker basket or barrel
trial_definition.input: Project-owned or properly licensed single reference image
trial_definition.post_processing: Blender retopology/LOD/UV/clean normals/appropriate collision; export STATIC FBX and PNG/TGA color/channel-packed maps
trial_definition.max_ue4_artefact: static mesh with soft asset path / asynchronous residency; do not import unoptimized generator geometry
required_evidence: generation wall-clock seconds and provider cost
GLB source hash and actual polygons/triangles
Unreal import results and no smoothing warnings
HISM/LOD collision and material budget for 2GB VRAM at 720p
manual visible comparison to already approved source assets

decision: TRELLIS.2 remains preferred evaluation candidate, but alternative approved CC0 geometry is used for current P1C01 until a real pilot can be run.
acceptance_boundary: Actual 3D generation experiment NOT RUN; feasibility/preflight test only; static JSON receipt no visual claim.
